subject: trying to view shiny_introduction.pdf on web browser; and it failed

messages.author: bdf6f6e5089760ac
messages.subject: trying to view shiny_introduction.pdf on web browser; and it failed
parts:
So I'm pretty new to shiny-server. But I think it's really cool to have such feature in R. 

I got it setup following instruction here: http://www.r-bloggers.com/deploying-shiny-server-on-amazon-ec2/ 

shiny-server is now running on http://54.244.150.28/ 

As you can see these are just example from RStudio. I notice there is a pdf file: shiny_introduction.pdf 

Once I tried to view the pdf file on web browser by following this url: http://54.244.150.28/shiny_introduction.pdf  , I was not able to view it and shiny-server failed and gave me the following error.  Do you know why and how to fix this issue?

/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/lib/main.js:202
  throw err;
        ^
TypeError: Arguments to path.join must be strings
    at path.js:360:15
    at Array.filter (native)
    at Object.exports.join (path.js:358:36)
    at /usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/lib/router/router.js:93:39
    at /usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/node_modules/q/q.js:388:35
From previous event:
    at Server.ShinyProxy.httpListener (/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/lib/proxy/http.js:93:6)
    at Server.new_handler (/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/node_modules/sockjs/lib/utils.js:85:20)
    at Server.EventEmitter.emit (events.js:117:20)
    at Server.emitter (/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/lib/server/server.js:193:15)
    at Server.EventEmitter.emit (events.js:98:17)
    at HTTPParser.parser.onIncoming (http.js:2022:12)
    at HTTPParser.parserOnHeadersComplete [as onHeadersComplete] (http.js:119:23)
    at Socket.socket.ondata (http.js:1912:22)

parts:
Thanks Joe for your help. Below is the shiny-server version and config file. I just used the default settings, except for the port. 

[ec2-user@ip-10-245-50-158 ~]$ shiny-server --version
Shiny Server v0.3.4
Node.js v0.10.1


[ec2-user@ip-10-245-50-158 ~]$ cat /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf 
run_as shiny;

server {
  listen 80;

  location / {
    site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
    log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;
    directory_index on;
  }
}

OK, thanks. The crash seems to happen on Node.js v0.10.x only. Can you see if this fixes it?

sudo npm install -g https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/archive/0365b8d668.tar.gz

If so, I will push this as Shiny Server v0.3.5 later today.
